ai_summary: 3i Infotech Ltd. experienced a significant overhaul of its Board of Directors following its 33rd Annual General Meeting, with three Non-Executive Non-Independent Directors departing. Two of these departures were non-routine, involving a director failing re-appointment and another being directly removed by shareholder resolution, signaling potential governance issues or shareholder discontent. This critically reduced the Board's strength to four directors, necessitating immediate reconstitution to ensure regulatory compliance and effective oversight.
